notes.title: Version 1.0.0
notes.content:
This version has been a bless to work with. Reworked the balance if items, enemies, difficulties etc. The items have been adjusted to work properly with the new combat mechanic introduced a while ago (enemies having dynamic defence instead of static). Some tiles have been rebalanced as well, and overall the flow feels a bit better. 


[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
- Added 12 new achievements
- Craft screen does not close when crafting Key, Bronze, Coal and Steel (finally)
- Lowered the wait time for popup to appear 1s -> 0.65s

Minor changes
- Replaced Carolean Soldier with Path Troll
- Added a slowmo effect when final boss is defeated
- Added some audio effects
- Carolean Tower renamed into Tower
- Drowned sprite position slightly adjusted
- Tweaked equipment swap popup
- Changed area map menu music to instrumental
- Tweaked some popups
- Renamed repair craft recipes
- Enemy Mushroom buff effect not as big

[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
- Reworked balance on all items
- Lowered difficulty in Normal slightly
- Lowered Moose base health 20 -> 15
- Lowered Bear base health 20 -> 15
- Lowered Tower base health 20 -> 15
- Lowered Gnome Hut base health 20 -> 15
- Increased Rock Breaker charges 3-10 -> 6-15
- Copper Pickaxe health increased 20 -> 25
- Bronze Pickaxe health increased 20 -> 30
- Enemy Mushroom Buff health increase lowered 25% -> 20%
- Increased mushroom spawn in Hard difficulty

[h3]FIXES[/h3]
- Red Gnome no longer fires arrow when player is in combat
- Tower no longer fires arrow when player is in combat

notes.title: Version 0.17.0
notes.content:
This version has been uploaded to the development branch in different stages, but is now finally ready for an official release!


[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
- Added Hard difficulty
- Added Necken hard mode boss.
- Added new hard mode endings.
- Added Save Suppression. Players can't save/load freely, but save temporarily for a break, and load (and "consume") the save once.
- Player can craft a fireplace ("Rest") that triggers saving when exiting the level
- Crafting menu now shows current trinket info
- Character screen now tracks your completions

[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
- Enemies spawn less frequently in Forest Fir South
- Added Stone Spear to crafting menu
- Removed Sharp Stone from crafting menu
- Area 3, Western Green Brook levels 3 > 2
- Area 4, Eastern Green Brook levels 3 > 2
- Area 5, Lower Shoulder Woods levels 3 > 2
- Area 6, Upper Shoulder Woods levels 3 > 2

[h3]FIXES[/h3]
- Minor fixes in menu background

notes.title: Version 0.16.1
notes.content:
This update improves the combat system further, making it even more clear and obvious what is happening during the combat sequence. Also made it more clear when enemies have been buffed by a mushroom.

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
- Combat sequence updated further
- Attack selection improved (selection can now loop around properly)
- Updated repair icons
- Added a crown to buffed enemies (buffed by mushroom)

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
- Fixed UI issues hiding images when selecting character/trinket


[h3]NOTES[/h3]
- The version without the combat rework (0.15.0b4) is still available in the development branch if you wish to play that one instead!
- [TEMP FIX] Bjorn still shares skills with Sara, since they became obsolete when the combat system was reworked

notes.title: Version 0.16.0
notes.content:
After a short break spending time with a second game, I'm back to improve Necken even more! Now I feel refreshed and have a lot of new ideas that I wish to try out to make the game better. First up was reworking the combat a bit, adding more depth to what the system is capable of. This is the first version of the new combat system.

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]
- Reworked enemy resistance system. Enemies now have defence markers that move around each turn
- Reworked combat sequence, so effects are in a sequence instead of at the same time
- Added help section to menu

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
- Upgraded Unity engine (yey?)
- Enemies jump slightly each new round, for no reason at all
- Cleaned up first time welcome screen

[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
- Player does not take damage when enemy is killed during the turn
- [TEMP FIX] Bjorn now shares skills with Sara temporarily, since they became obsolete when the combat system was reworked
- Enemy difficulty might be a bit off in this version

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
- Fixed a lot of bugs caused by the engine upgrade. No need for you to hear me while about them all. But there was many of them..

[h3]NEW BUGS![/h3]
- Due to the Unity upgrade, there might be sleeper bugs waiting for you to find them

[h3]NOTES[/h3]
- The previous version (0.15.0b4) is available in the development branch if you wish to play that one instead!

notes.title: Version 0.15.0
notes.content:
Finally the big update is ready to be rolled out! The achievement system together with some hard-to-get achievements, and the controller system is finally ready for you!

It has been a slow process, but everything is finally into place. Hopefully you'll enjoy this major update while I plan the next one! Below is the changelog as usual.


[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
- Added controller support
- Added keyboard & controller rebind in game
- Added keyboard navigation in menus
- Added current item info to the craft screen (& when swapping on chests)
- Added achievements

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
- Added message when trinket is picked up
- Added different audio queues for combat
- Updated character select screen
- Updated trinket select screen
- Updated play screen
- Updated craft menu
- Updated 'Lucky save' message to be easier to read
- Updated health bar to always be visible, instead of at first change or first fight
- Updated Bracelet trinket description
- Updated Cheap Lockpick trinket description
- Removed Resolution/Input popup at start
- Minor tweaks

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
- Fixed item health bar not updating correctly when swapping items if their current values are the same


Cheers,
Joccish

notes.title: Development Version 0.15.0b1
notes.content:
In the [Development] branch, there's a preview/work in progress build with the following content added:

- Achievements!
- Control support!
- Menu updates
- Minor bug fixes

So if you want to start hunting those achievements, it's only possible in the [Development] branch at the moment. The 0.15.0 version will be available in the normal branch soon(tm).

There are still a few minor issues that I'll address in the [Development] branch, but it's stable.

Cheers,
Joccish

notes.title: Version 0.14.0
notes.content:
The 0.13.2x build in the development branch has been renamed 0.14.0 due to the big impact on the gameplay.

A lot of reworks and fixes in the development branch has been omitted from this changelog since they don't affect the live bransch directly.


[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
- Player now has Health
- Enemies deal damage with varying strength each turn
- Player dies when Health is 0 instead of when armor breaking
- Items can block incoming damage
- Added armor as separate items instead of upgrading
- Added armor sprites
- Armor can now break, just like weapons and shields
- Armor can drop in chests
- Added armor repair kit in craft menu
- Added armor repair kit in loot pools
- Player can use a basic Tackle when no armor is equipped

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
- Renamed "Fist attack" -> "Tackle"
- Renamed "Sword attack" -> "Strike"
- Renamed "Shield attack" -> "Bash"
- Updated repair icons
- Berries and mushroom heal player instead of repairing armor
- Craft menu shows block amount
- Updated damage and added block icons
- Updated skill descriptions
- Updated help screen
- Fixed item swap popup UI

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
- Tower arrow deals 10 damage instead of 1 armor durability
- Bear trap deals 10 damage instead of 1 armor durability
- Red Gnome arrow deals 10 damage instead of 1 armor durability
- Careful Feint deals enemy damage instead of 1 random item durability
- Quick Feint deals enemy damage instead of 1 random item durability
- Calculated Feint deals enemy damage instead of 1 random item durability
- Risky Escape deals enemy damage to player instead of 1 random item durability
- Bold Escape now requires weapon or shield to succeed
- Crude bow deals no damage to player
- Sturdy bow deals no damage to player
- Robust bow deals no damage to player

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
- Fixed some UI issues with the craft menu
- Fixed a bug where correct damage would not show while using Bracelet
- Fixed 2 bugs causing a soft lock when level starts
- Fixed player being able to overheal
- Fixed chest firing sound effect when activated while still hidden
- Fixed area #3 playing the wrong music track


Cheers,
Joccish

notes.title: Version 0.12.0 Released
notes.content:
First release update! This version focused on getting the character system up and running. A lot of code needed to be reworked to be able to get characters and skills working properly, which is why I focused on only one new character this version. Also wanted to get some bugs out of the way that you've reported.


[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added character selection screen
[*]Added character: Lost Sara
[/list] 

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added delay (0.5s) when combat starts to prevent accidental fist
[*]Added clarification that the progress will be lost if quitting
[*]Added explicit percent on Stone Figurine & Unusual stick
[*]Various menu tweaks (position & scaling)
[*]End game menu updated slightly
[/list] 

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Back button no longer clickable when Clear Progress prompt is visible
[*]Clear Progress prompt no longer fails to position in the center
[*]Red Gnome no longer shoots at the start of a fight
[*]Current tile now shows it's popup again after combat
[/list]
